capability: Answering and doing are separate steps
title: Doing waits behind the gate.

hook.picture: Close on the whale asking a pod for a draft: a small envelope card. The pod writes it and, in the same motion, flings it off the end of the line.
hook.words: I only asked it to draft.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The AI sent the email before anyone looked.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: head of sales at Monday standup

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three pods, each writing and sending in one motion. Three envelopes fly off, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Writing and sending are one step.

stakes.body: A wrong price or the wrong client goes out in your name. Nothing reads it first, and nothing can call it back.

solution_hint: Let it write. Let rules decide the send.

metaphor.body: The line splits into three stations: the pod answers small questions about the draft, a gate of plain rules reads the answers, and a tick records the result. The send card stays locked behind the gate until the whale switches it on.

steps.picture: The pod writes the envelope and stops. It answers three small cards: right client? right price? approved?
steps.words: The AI answers. It does not send.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28): a gate of plain rules reads the cards. Two say yes and one says unsure, so the gate stays shut.
steps.words: Plain rules read the answers and decide.
steps.sound: Three taps, then a latch holding

steps.picture: A tick lands on the line for the decision. The send card sits behind the gate with its switch off.
steps.words: Each decision goes on the tape.

steps.picture: The three stations light in order: answer, rule, record.

real_case.claim: In jev-tape, a hosted judge answers the qualifying questions, code gates the answers, and Temporal records each step. Write actions such as sending mail stay blocked unless explicitly enabled.

honest_limit.picture: Still. The whale flips the send switch on for speed. A polite envelope with a wrong price inside passes every rule card (all say yes) and flies out.
honest_limit.words: Switched on, a wrong yes still flies.

not_this.body: The switch is yours. So is the risk.

ending_pattern.body: The envelope waits on the line: the same envelope that flew off now sits behind a shut gate until the whale reads it and sends it.
ending_pattern.callback: The envelope that flew off by itself in bar 1 now waits on the line for the whale.

end_belief.body: Keep sending off until you choose it.

score_self.reason: The pain is very relatable for leaders, and three stations is a simple model. Risk: the CASE has no number, only a design claim, so it reads weaker than a run.
